owf0.title: Cruise crew change Valletta–Athens
owf0.blurb: MSC Cruises crew travel swaps 176 crew of a cruise ship: they board in Valletta and must meet the ship in Athens on 18 Aug. One way; the aircraft comes back empty. The ship sails without them if we're late.
owf0.hook: Follow-on: CS-TQM is free at LHR from 18 Aug

owfi.title: Easter wet lease, Casablanca
owfi.blurb: Royal Air Maroc wants an A320-size aircraft (180+ seats) based at CMN from 1 Apr to 19 Nov, flying to Düsseldorf, Las Palmas, Palma de Mallorca and Lisbon: 2 waves a day from 06:00 local and a maintenance night every 7 days. MGH 200 BH a month; they plan about 242. Crews live in Casablanca hotels at the client's cost. Full repaint in their colours, 10 days in a paint shop (a condition of the deal); they pay the paint and the repaint after.
owfi.hook: Repeat business from Royal Air Maroc

owjg.title: Cup tie in Budapest
owjg.blurb: Real Madrid play in Budapest on 24 Sep. Out the day before, back straight after the match at 23:00 local; extra time can push it. Two extra cabin crew for the team service. They want a premium cabin (12+ business seats).

ox5m.title: AUSSOM contingent swap, Mogadishu
ox5m.blurb: Portuguese Ministry of National Defence: 3 rotations LIS–MGQ for the peacekeeping contingent, every 42 days or so from 4 Oct. Night-stop at MGQ, security-vetted crew, payment in arrears.

oxki.title: Evacuation flights from Beirut
oxki.blurb: Beirut: the national carrier has flown its fleet out to Cyprus for safety. The Portuguese Ministry of Foreign Affairs needs 2 flights BEY–LIS for about 160 citizens, first departure 6 Aug 13:30 local. Permits are filed but may slip; payment after the job, governments pay late.

rivalBid.why: quoted about 12 % under the asking rate and could fly tonight

oxki.lostWhy: quoted about 12 % under the asking rate and could fly tonight

oxyl.title: Trade-fair delegation to Porto
oxyl.blurb: Novartis is moving a trade-fair delegation of 126 from ZRH to OPO on 10 Aug; one way, we ferry back empty. They want one all-in price: fuel, fees and handling on us.

oy24.title: Peacekeeper rotation for MINUSCA
oy24.blurb: Portuguese Ministry of National Defence: 3 rotations LIS–BGF for the stabilisation force, every 17 days or so from 15 Sep. Night-stop at BGF, security-vetted crew, payment in arrears.

oyij.title: Diaspora charter PRG–BVC
oyij.blurb: Čedok's Boa Vista charter for Christmas and New Year: grandparents, children and a hold full of presents. Out 15 Sep, back 6 days later. The client pays $75 a block hour for each extra cabin crew member (1 wanted).

oyiu.title: Tour hops
oyiu.blurb: AEG Presents: band, crew and 14 tonnes of kit hopping London, Milan, Brussels and Zurich over a week, one-way legs the morning after each show. Expect late load-outs and a picky rider.

oyjn.title: Pre-season tour to Bangkok
oyjn.blurb: FC Barcelona take the squad, sponsors and a fan club to Bangkok for a 8-day pre-season tour. Branded headrests and a nutritionist menu; two extra cabin crew. They want a premium cabin (20+ business seats).

oz4y.title: League away day in Hamburg
oz4y.blurb: Fortuna Düsseldorf play in Hamburg on 4 Oct. Out the day before, back straight after the match at 23:00 local; extra time can push it. Two extra cabin crew for the team service. They want a premium cabin (12+ business seats).

rivalBid.why: quoted about 12 % under the asking rate

oz4y.lostWhy: quoted about 12 % under the asking rate

ozkz.title: Pilgrimage Dublin–Medjugorje
ozkz.blurb: Joe Walsh Tours is bringing a parish group from Dublin to Medjugorje, with a coach over the border waiting at the other end. Out 23 Aug, home 3 days later.
ozkz.lostWhy: took it when our offer lapsed without an answer

ozqr.title: League away package: 3 trips
ozqr.blurb: SL Benfica want one operator for their next 3 away games (Porto, Funchal and Ponta Delgada), roughly every 8 days. Out the day before, back after the match at 23:00 local. Two extra cabin crew. They want a premium cabin (12+ business seats).

ozqw.title: Film crew with their kit to Amman
ozqw.blurb: Short notice from Corendon: a film crew with their kit, 102 passengers, AMS–AMM on 24 Oct, return 7 days later. All-in charter; their group leader will want the seat plan by tomorrow.
ozqw.lostWhy: took it when our offer lapsed without an answer

ozrg.title: Extra capacity at Hamburg
ozrg.blurb: Condor wants A320-family aircraft (168+ seats) based at HAM from 19 Sep to 31 Oct, flying to Barcelona, Alicante, Palma de Mallorca, Cagliari and Corfu: 2 waves a day from 06:00 local and a maintenance night every 7 days. MGH 200 BH a month; they plan about 251. Crews live in Hamburg hotels at the client's cost.

o102h.title: Brochure flights to Antalya
o102h.blurb: Corendon: 9 weekly rotations every Friday, 5 Nov–31 Dec. Out at 08:30 local, back the same day; no fuel stops. Paid per rotation with a fuel-escalation clause.
o102h.hook: Follow-on: CS-TCH is free at LHR from 5 Nov

o102u.title: Grounded-jet cover at Dakar
o102u.blurb: Air Sénégal has an aircraft grounded at DSS after a tyre burst on the landing roll. They need cover from 15:00 local tomorrow for 8 days, flying their schedule to Abuja, Las Palmas, Marrakesh and Málaga. Premium rate, MGH 8 BH a day; positioning is billable, so the sooner we're there the better.
o102u.lostWhy: took it when our offer lapsed without an answer

events.title: Ground handling strike at Lisbon, Porto and Faro
events.body: Ground staff at Portugal's main airports strike until 13 Mar. Minimum services keep flights moving, but turnarounds take about an hour longer.

events.title: Pratt & Whitney orders more GTF inspections: 40 A320neos grounded across Wizz Air and IndiGo
events.body: Another round of engine inspections grounds about 40 A320neo-family aircraft for months. Airlines with neos want wet-leased A320s and 737s, and ACMI rates for narrowbodies are rising.

events.title: Clashes in Tripoli close Mitiga
events.body: Militias are fighting around Mitiga airport. Libya's airspace is closed until at least 26 Mar; Malta is the staging point for evacuations.

events.title: Earthquake in the High Atlas
events.body: A strong earthquake south of Marrakesh has flattened mountain villages. Rescue teams and field hospitals are flying in through Marrakesh.

events.title: Lufthansa pilots strike (Vereinigung Cockpit)
events.body: Lufthansa's pilots are out until 20 Apr. Eurowings and Condor are short of aircraft for the extra passengers and want wet-leased cover at short notice.

events.title: Earthquake in the High Atlas
events.body: A strong earthquake south of Marrakesh has flattened mountain villages. Rescue teams and field hospitals are flying in through Marrakesh.

events.title: Lufthansa pilots strike (Vereinigung Cockpit)
events.body: Lufthansa's pilots are out until 1 Jun. Eurowings and Condor are short of aircraft for the extra passengers and want wet-leased cover at short notice.

events.title: TAROM grounds its fleet
events.body: TAROM has grounded its fleet after the state stopped its rescue aid. Its summer flying is up for grabs, and airlines want wet-leased aircraft fast.

events.title: Fighting reaches Khartoum: Sudan closes its airspace
events.body: Heavy fighting has spread from Khartoum. Sudan's airspace is closed to overflights until at least 30 Jun; foreign ministries are evacuating through Port Sudan to Jeddah.

events.title: Wildfires on Rhodes: holidaymakers evacuated
events.body: Wildfires have forced hotels in the south of Rhodes to evacuate until at least 6 Aug. The airport stays open; tour operators want extra flights to bring their guests home.
